0022600213.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-6, 12th in the West) host the LA Clippers (2-7, 13th in the West) in the Suns' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams having played nine games. Phoenix is 3-3 at home and 0-3 on the road and enters after a loss, while the Clippers are 2-3 at home, 0-4 on the road, and coming off a win. Mark Williams is out for the Suns with a shoulder injury that required surgery, and the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on February 1, 2026, in Phoenix, where the Suns lost 117-93.
